row.notes: MSVC x64 CRT strcmp(s1, s2): compares bytes until s1 is 8-byte aligned, then a qword at a time with unaligned s2 loads, falling back to bytes on a mismatch or when s2 is within 8 bytes of a 4 KiB page end (0x14535d880). Bytes compare unsigned and it returns -1, 0 or 1 in the full rax, not a difference. 5366 direct calls (4867 in .xtls from 2048 functions, 499 in .data1) and 43 jumps (9 in .xtls, 34 in .data1, 33 of them nop+jmp stubs); its address is OpenSSL lhash's default comparator (0x144f15e41). Callers include the cutscene command parser, morph rig parse and asset resolve.
